+   "text": "The coinduced embedding makes each orbit map locally constant. If tau fixes m, induction shows every nonnegative integer fixes m. +   "uses": [
+    "lem-exc-coinduced-discrete-embedding"
+   ],

+  },

+   "elementary": true
+  },
+  {
+   "text": "For a coefficient map, naturality of t and the cycles inclusion show equality after composition with the invariant inclusion. That inclusion is monic, giving naturality of the homology isomorphisms.",
+   "uses": [],
+   "elementary": true
+  }
+ ],
+ "proof_deps": [
+  "lem-exc-coinduced-discrete-embedding"
+ ],

+/-!
+# The explicit two-term complex of an action
+
+Source: blueprint, lem-exc-procyclic-two-term, first proof paragraph.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+universe u v w
+
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits
+
+namespace Rep
+
+variable (A : Type u) [Ring A] (G : Type v) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
+    [IsTopologicalGroup G]
+
+/-- Terms of the two-term action complex. -/
+def actionTwoTermX (M : DiscreteContinuousRep.{u, v, w} A G) : ℕ → ModuleCat.{w} A
+  | 0 => (ModuleCat.of A M.obj.V : ModuleCat.{w} A)
+  | 1 => (ModuleCat.of A M.obj.V : ModuleCat.{w} A)
+  | _ + 2 => ModuleCat.of A PUnit.{w + 1}
+
+/-- Its sole nonzero differential is the action of `τ` minus the identity. -/
+def actionTwoTermD (τ : G) (M : DiscreteContinuousRep.{u, v, w} A G) :
+    ∀ n : ℕ, actionTwoTermX A G M n ⟶ actionTwoTermX A G M (n + 1)
+  | 0 => ModuleCat.ofHom (M.obj.ρ τ - LinearMap.id)
+  | _ + 1 => 0
+
+/-- The complex is explicitly constructed, without selecting any existence witness. -/
+def actionTwoTermObj (τ : G) (M : DiscreteContinuousRep.{u, v, w} A G) :
+    CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{w} A) ℕ :=
+  CochainComplex.of (actionTwoTermX A G M) (actionTwoTermD A G τ M)
+    (by intro n; cases n <;> simp [actionTwoTermD])
+
+/-- The same coefficient map in degrees zero and one, and zero elsewhere. -/
+def actionTwoTermMap (τ : G) {M N : DiscreteContinuousRep.{u, v, w} A G}
+    (f : M ⟶ N) : actionTwoTermObj A G τ M ⟶ actionTwoTermObj A G τ N :=
+  CochainComplex.ofHom
+    (fun n ↦ match n with
+      | 0 => ModuleCat.ofHom f.hom.hom.toLinearMap
+      | 1 => ModuleCat.ofHom f.hom.hom.toLinearMap
+      | _ + 2 => 0)
+    (by
+      intro n
+      cases n with
+      | zero =>
+        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
+        apply LinearMap.ext
+        intro x
+        change M.obj.V at x
+        change (N.obj.ρ τ) (f.hom.hom x) - f.hom.hom x =
+          f.hom.hom (M.obj.ρ τ x - x)
+        rw [map_sub]
+        exact congrArg (fun y ↦ y - f.hom.hom x) (Rep.hom_comm_apply f.hom τ x).symm
+      | succ n =>
+        simp [actionTwoTermObj, CochainComplex.of_d, actionTwoTermD])
+
+/-- The functorial two-term action complex with differential action minus identity.
+
+The coefficient map is used in both nonzero degrees; equivariance is exactly the
+chain-map equation, and all remaining maps have zero source or target.
+Source: blueprint lem-exc-procyclic-two-term, first proof paragraph
+(blueprint: def-exc-action-two-term-complex). -/
+def actionTwoTerm (τ : G) : DiscreteContinuousRep.{u, v, w} A G ⥤
+    CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{w} A) ℕ where
+  obj := actionTwoTermObj A G τ
+  map := actionTwoTermMap A G τ
+  map_id M := by
+    ext n
+    cases n with
+    | zero => rfl
+    | succ n => cases n <;> simp [actionTwoTermMap, actionTwoTermObj, actionTwoTermX]
+  map_comp f g := by
+    ext n
+    cases n with
+    | zero => rfl
+    | succ n =>
+      cases n with
+      | zero => rfl
+      | succ n => simp [actionTwoTermMap]
+
+/-- Degree zero is the coefficient module. -/
+noncomputable def actionTwoTermEquivZero (τ : G) (M : DiscreteContinuousRep.{u, v, w} A G) :
+    ((actionTwoTerm A G τ).obj M).X 0 ≃ₗ[A] M.obj.V := LinearEquiv.refl A _
+
+/-- Degree one is the coefficient module. -/
+noncomputable def actionTwoTermEquivOne (τ : G) (M : DiscreteContinuousRep.{u, v, w} A G) :
+    ((actionTwoTerm A G τ).obj M).X 1 ≃ₗ[A] M.obj.V := LinearEquiv.refl A _
+
+/-- There are no terms above degree one. -/
+theorem actionTwoTerm_isZero (τ : G) (M : DiscreteContinuousRep.{u, v, w} A G)
+    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : IsZero (((actionTwoTerm A G τ).obj M).X n) := by
+  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
+  change IsZero (actionTwoTermX A G M (2 + n))
+  rw [Nat.add_comm]
+  exact ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr (by
+    change Subsingleton PUnit.{w + 1}
+    infer_instance)
+
+end Rep

+/-- The two-term action complex gives a cohomological delta-functor.

+/-- Positive two-term cohomology is effaced by continuous coinduction.

+Proof: embed the coefficient module by its orbit map into the right-translation module
+of locally constant functions. The periodic primitive theorem makes translation minus
+identity surjective there. Thus degree-one homology is zero. All higher terms are zero,
+so their homology vanishes as well. Evaluation at one shows the orbit map is injective,
+and hence monic. Its induced map to the zero positive cohomology is zero.

+        HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{w} A) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q) →

+  dsimp only

+          (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ_[l])) (D.obj M) q (by omega))).isZero_homology

+/-!
+# Fixed vectors for the additive generator of the l-adic integers
+
+Source: blueprint lem-exc-procyclic-two-term, first proof paragraph.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section

+universe u w
+
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits

+namespace Rep
+
+set_option linter.style.haveILetI false in
+/-- A vector fixed by the additive generator is invariant under all l-adic integers.
+
+Proof: the orbit map is locally constant by the coinduced embedding. It is constant
+on nonnegative integer multiples of the generator by induction. Those multiples are
+dense in the l-adic integers, so continuity makes the orbit map constant everywhere.
+Source: blueprint lem-exc-procyclic-two-term, first paragraph
+(blueprint: lem-exc-procyclic-homology-zero). -/
+private theorem procyclic_fixed_iff (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (A : Type u) [Ring A] [Finite A]
+    (M : DiscreteContinuousRep.{u, 0, w} A (Multiplicative ℤ_[l])) (m : M.obj.V) :
+    M.obj.ρ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ_[l])) m = m ↔
+      ∀ g : Multiplicative ℤ_[l], M.obj.ρ g m = m := by
+  constructor
+  · intro hm
+    obtain ⟨D, e, ι, _, _, hι, _⟩ :=
+      exists_coinduced_discrete_embedding.{0, u, w} (Multiplicative ℤ_[l]) A
+    let f : LocallyConstant (Multiplicative ℤ_[l]) M.obj.V :=
+      e M ((ι.app M).hom.hom m)
+    have hf (g : Multiplicative ℤ_[l]) : f g = M.obj.ρ g m := hι M m g
+    have hn (n : ℕ) : M.obj.ρ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (n : ℤ_[l])) m = m := by
+      induction n with
+      | zero => simp
+      | succ n ih =>
+        rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
+        change M.obj.ρ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (n : ℤ_[l]) *
+          Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ_[l])) m = m
+        rw [map_mul]
+        change M.obj.ρ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (n : ℤ_[l]))
+          (M.obj.ρ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ_[l])) m) = m
+        rw [hm, ih]

+    letI : DiscreteTopology M.obj.V := ⟨rfl⟩
+    have heq : (fun x : ℤ_[l] ↦ f (Multiplicative.ofAdd x)) = fun _ ↦ m := by
+      apply PadicInt.denseRange_natCast.equalizer f.continuous continuous_const
+      funext n
+      exact (hf _).trans (hn n)
+    intro g
+    exact (hf g).symm.trans (congrFun heq (Multiplicative.toAdd g))
+  · intro h
+    exact h _

+`procyclic_fixed_iff`. The universal property of the kernel identifies it with cycles.

+commute with both inclusions, proving naturality by cancellation of a monomorphism.
+Source: blueprint lem-exc-procyclic-two-term, first proof paragraph
+(blueprint: lem-exc-procyclic-homology-zero). -/

+    (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ_[l]))

+      V.obj M ⟶ (K.obj M).X 0 :=
+    ModuleCat.ofHom ((⨅ g, LinearMap.ker (M.obj.ρ g - LinearMap.id)).subtype.comp
+      (t M).toLinearMap)

+    Subtype.val_injective.comp (t M).injective
+  have hex (M) : Function.Exact (i M).hom ((K.obj M).d 0 1).hom := by
+    intro x

+    rw [sub_eq_zero, procyclic_fixed_iff]

+          LinearMap.id_apply, sub_eq_zero]
+        exact hx
+      exact ⟨(t M).symm ⟨x, hx'⟩, congrArg Subtype.val ((t M).apply_symm_apply _)⟩
+    · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩ g

+
+Source: blueprint lem-exc-procyclic-two-term, third proof paragraph.

+@[expose] public section

+universe w

+open scoped BigOperators
+open CategoryTheory Topology

+namespace Rep

+private theorem reduction_locallyConstant (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (r : ℕ) :
+    IsLocallyConstant (PadicInt.toZModPow (p := l) r) := by
+  apply (IsLocallyConstant.iff_exists_open _).mpr
+  intro x
+  let ε : ℝ := (l : ℝ) ^ (-(r : ℤ))
+  have hε : 0 < ε := zpow_pos (by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos) _
+  refine ⟨Metric.ball x ε, Metric.isOpen_ball, Metric.mem_ball_self hε, ?_⟩
+  intro y hy
+  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
+  rw [← map_sub, ← RingHom.mem_ker, PadicInt.ker_toZModPow]
+  apply (PadicInt.norm_le_pow_iff_mem_span_pow _ _).mp
+  exact le_of_lt (by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hy)

+private theorem periodic_sum
+    {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] (f : ℕ → M) (L : ℕ)
+    (hf : ∀ n, f (n + L) = f n) (k : ℕ) :
+    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (L * k), f n) = k • ∑ n ∈ Finset.range L, f n := by
+  have hshift (n t : ℕ) : f (n + L * t) = f n := by
+    induction t with
+    | zero => simp
+    | succ t ih =>
+      rw [Nat.mul_succ, ← Nat.add_assoc, hf, ih]
+  induction k with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ k ih =>
+    rw [Nat.mul_succ, Finset.sum_range_add, ih, succ_nsmul]
+    congr 1
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro n hn
+    simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using hshift n k
+
+private theorem cyclic_primitive
+    {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : ℕ → M)
+    (hz : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n) = 0) (a : ZMod N) :
+    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (a + 1).val, f n) -
+      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range a.val, f n) = f a.val := by
+  have hval : (a + 1).val = (a.val + 1) % N := by
+    rw [← Nat.cast_one, ← ZMod.natCast_zmod_val a, ← Nat.cast_add, ZMod.val_natCast]
+    rw [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (ZMod.val_lt a)]
+  by_cases h : a.val + 1 < N
+  · rw [hval, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h, Finset.sum_range_succ, add_sub_cancel_left]
+  · have heq : a.val + 1 = N := by have := ZMod.val_lt a; omega
+    rw [hval, heq, Nat.mod_self, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_sub]
+    have hs : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range a.val, f n) + f a.val = 0 := by
+      rw [← Finset.sum_range_succ, heq, hz]
+    exact neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero.mpr hs
+
+set_option linter.style.haveILetI false in
+/-- Every locally constant function to an l-power torsion group has a locally constant
+primitive for translation by one.
+
+Proof: choose an open subgroup fixing the function under translation. A sufficiently small
+power of l lies in this subgroup. The function therefore has period L = l^r on integers.
+On N = L*l^s residues its sum is l^s times a sum, hence zero. Its partial sums on the
+standard representatives of Z/NZ satisfy the difference equation, including at N-1 because
+the total sum is zero. Pull these partial sums back along reduction. The kernel of reduction
+is contained in the chosen open subgroup, so the right side is the original function.
